traits.summary: You have a flying speed of 50 feet.

recommendation.text: A bird-like humanoid with flight and talon attacks. Flight is powerful, but managing aerial positioning and reach can be punishing for new players.

traits.name: Unending Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you aren't incapacitated.
traits.summary: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you aren't incapacitated.

traits.name: Mingle with the Wind
traits.description: You can cast levitate once per long rest without material components. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.
traits.summary: You can cast levitate once per long rest without material components.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.description: You can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without spending extra movement.
traits.summary: You can move across difficult terrain made of earth or stone without spending extra movement.

traits.name: Merge with Stone
traits.description: You can cast pass without trace once per long rest without material components. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.
traits.summary: You can cast pass without trace once per long rest without material components.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, in shades of gray.
traits.summary: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, in shades of gray.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.
traits.summary: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.description: You know produce flame. At 3rd level you can cast burning hands once per long rest as a 1st-level spell. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.
traits.summary: You know produce flame.

traits.name: Acid Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to acid damage.
traits.summary: You have resistance to acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.
traits.summary: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swim
traits.description: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.
traits.summary: You have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Call to the Wave
traits.description: You know shape water. At 3rd level you can cast create or destroy water once per long rest as a 2nd-level spell. Constitution is your spellcasting ability.
traits.summary: You know shape water.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.
traits.summary: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: You know the poison spray cantrip. You can cast animal friendship at will with this trait, targeting only snakes. From 3rd level you can also cast suggestion once per long rest with this trait. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
traits.summary: Poison spray cantrip, animal friendship on snakes at will, suggestion once per long rest from 3rd level.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
traits.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Poison Immunity
traits.description: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.
traits.summary: You are immune to poison damage and the poisoned condition.

recommendation.text: A serpent-touched humanoid with innate spellcasting and poison immunity. Flavorful, but the extra spell list and immunity interactions add complexity.

traits.name: Grovel, Cower, and Beg
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can cower to distract nearby foes. Until the end of your next turn, your allies have advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet of you.
traits.summary: As a bonus action, you distract foes so that your allies have advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 10 feet of you until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: You have advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
traits.summary: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of your non-incapacitated allies is within 5 feet of it.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight while you, your target, or what you look at is in direct sunlight.
traits.summary: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight while you, your target, or what you look at is in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by **1d12** + your Constitution modifier. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
traits.summary: When you take damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 1d12 + your Constitution modifier. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.
traits.summary: You are treated as one size larger for the purpose of determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Natural Athlete
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.
traits.summary: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.description: You are acclimated to high altitude and have resistance to cold damage.
traits.summary: You are acclimated to high altitude and have resistance to cold damage.

traits.name: Armored Casing
traits.description: Without armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.
traits.summary: Without armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

traits.name: Built for Success
traits.description: Add a d4 to one attack roll, ability check or saving throw you make, after seeing the roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
traits.summary: Add a d4 to one attack roll, ability check or saving throw you make, after seeing the roll.

traits.name: Healing Machine
traits.description: Mending can heal you as if it were cure wounds. Spells that only work on humanoids, such as cure wounds and healing word, work on you too.
traits.summary: Mending can heal you as if it were cure wounds.

traits.name: Mechanical Nature
traits.description: You have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against being paralyzed or poisoned. You don't need to eat, drink or breathe.
traits.summary: You have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against being paralyzed or poisoned.

traits.name: Sentry's Rest
traits.description: On a long rest, you spend at least 6 hours inactive but conscious instead of sleeping.
traits.summary: On a long rest, you spend at least 6 hours inactive but conscious instead of sleeping.

traits.name: Specialized Design
traits.description: You gain proficiency with two tools of your choice.
traits.summary: You gain proficiency with two tools of your choice.

recommendation.text: A mechanical gnome with a built-in tool and limited flight. Fun tinker theme, but the mechanical features add small but persistent complexity.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: You can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without equipment, and you have advantage on checks to start or escape a grapple.
traits.summary: You can squeeze through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without equipment, and you have advantage on checks to start or escape a grapple.

traits.description: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour.

traits.name: Natural Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to acid and poison damage, and advantage on saves against being poisoned.
traits.summary: You have resistance to acid and poison damage, and advantage on saves against being poisoned.

traits.name: Shape Self
traits.description: As an action, reshape your body: grow or retract a pseudopod up to 10 feet long that can carry up to 10 pounds, or change your form to look humanoid. A bonus action ends it.
traits.summary: As an action, reshape your body: grow or retract a pseudopod up to 10 feet long that can carry up to 10 pounds, or change your form to look humanoid.

recommendation.text: An ooze-like creature with flexible anatomy and poison resistance. Niche defensive toolkit that rewards experienced positioning.

traits.name: Carapace
traits.description: Without armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.
traits.summary: Without armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

traits.name: Chameleon Carapace
traits.description: As an action, change your carapace color to match your surroundings, giving advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide there.
traits.summary: As an action, change your carapace color to match your surroundings, giving advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide there.

traits.name: Secondary Arms
traits.description: You have two smaller arms that can wield light weapons, manipulate objects, open doors and hold things.
traits.summary: You have two smaller arms that can wield light weapons, manipulate objects, open doors and hold things.

traits.name: Sleepless
traits.description: You don't need to sleep and stay conscious during a long rest. Magic can't put you to sleep.
traits.summary: You don't need to sleep and stay conscious during a long rest.

traits.name: Thri-kreen Telepathy
traits.description: You can speak telepathically to a creature within 120 feet that shares a language with you, without it replying.
traits.summary: You can speak telepathically to a creature within 120 feet that shares a language with you, without it replying.

traits.summary: Gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.
